text: The Rowanwood Watermain replacement is a major construction project. Parking restrictions to safely accommodate the construction on Rowanwood Avenue and surrounding streets will temporarily displace residential permit parking. To mitigate the impact on residents with valid street parking permits, Engineering and Construction Services in consultation with Transportation Services recommends permit parking be implemented on a temporary basis on nearby streets, including Mathersfield Drive and Chestnut Park, where existing parking regulations can be adjusted to accommodate displaced permit holders. At its meeting of May 28, 2026 City Council adopted Item TE33.58 which provided authorization for Toronto and East York Community Council to temporarily implement permit parking on Mathersfield Drive, between Pricefield Road and the Mathersfield Drive east leg and on Chestnut Park, between…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Mathersfield Drive, between a point 105 metres north and east of Pricefield Road and Mathersfield Drive (easterly north/south leg), until December 31, 2027. 2. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Chestnut Park, between Roxborough Street East (most westerly intersection) and Thornwood Road, until December 31, 2027. 3. Authorized permit parking to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. daily on the even (north) side of Mathersfield Drive, between Pricefield Road and the Mathersfield Drive east leg, until December 31, 2027. 4.
